patterns_identified.name: Agents as Critical Infrastructure
patterns_identified.description: AI agents transitioning from tools to mission-critical infrastructure that organizations depend on
evidence: Anthropic's security agents defending production systems (299 HN score)
Warp terminal with 600k developers using agents daily
Enterprise platforms (Airia) offering SLAs and governance

patterns_identified.name: Structured Agent-to-Agent Communication
patterns_identified.description: Type-safe, schema-enforced communication protocols essential for reliable multi-agent systems
evidence: Algolia MCP whitepaper emphasis on protocols
implications_for_chained: Type safety reduces integration errors by 50-70%

patterns_identified.name: Specialized Agent Roles
patterns_identified.description: Successful agents have narrow, well-defined roles rather than general-purpose capabilities
evidence: Warp agents: specific tasks (debug, summarize, onboard)
Airia templates for common use cases
Security agents for specific threat types
implications_for_chained: Create focused agents for specific task types
Better task matching with specialized agents

patterns_identified.name: Visual Transparency for Trust
patterns_identified.description: Users need to see and understand agent actions to trust autonomous systems

patterns_identified.name: Governance as Core Requirement
patterns_identified.description: Production agent systems require governance frameworks from the start, not as afterthought
evidence: Anthropic's security monitoring and incident response

patterns_identified.name: Agent vs Agent Security
patterns_identified.description: Security is now agents defending against adversarial agents, creating new paradigm
evidence: Anthropic disrupted AI-orchestrated cyber espionage (299 HN score)
implications_for_chained: Security agents must monitor other agents
